shop.name: Corner shop
shop.intro: Mum needs milk. Buy one bottle at Mabel's stall and bring it back to the alley.

steps.text: Walk out of the alley and across the road to Mabel's stall.

hint.legs: Hold W to walk, A and D to turn.
hint.arms: Nothing to grab yet. Keep the hands still: flapping hands look odd.
hint.head: Look around with the mouse. Nod (N) if someone says hello.
hint.all: Hold W to walk, A and D to turn. Out of the alley to the right, then across to Mabel's stall.

steps.text: Stand still and wait for Mabel.

hint.legs: Stop and stand still on the spot.
hint.head: Look at Mabel. A nod is polite.
hint.all: Let go of W and stand still. If Mabel says hello, press N to nod.

steps.text: Take the milk from the counter.

hint.legs: Stay put. Step closer only if the arms say 'too far'.
hint.arms: Move a hand to the glowing ring, then G to grab.
hint.head: Keep Mabel happy: nod if she looks at you.
hint.all: Hold G: the hand reaches for the milk and grabs it.

steps.text: Say thank you to Mabel.

hint.head: Press T and say thank you out loud (or Enter to type it, or hold Space to mumble).
hint.all: Press T and say thank you out loud (or Enter to type it).

steps.text: Carry the milk back to the alley.

hint.legs: Walk back. Heavy hands wobble: no sharp turns.
hint.arms: Don't let go of the milk.
hint.head: Watch for Gus. Nod back if he says hello.
hint.all: Walk the milk back to the alley. Go slowly: a heavy hand leans the coat.

bank.name: Bank
bank.intro: Dad's birthday money is waiting at the bank. Queue, sign for it, take the cash out to the corner.

steps.text: Walk into the bank.
Stand still in the queue.
Hold the form flat with one hand and sign with the other.
Take the cash.
Carry the cash out to the corner.

cinema.name: Cinema
cinema.intro: A grown-up film. Get snacks from the cart, pass Pip's height check at the door, and get in.

steps.text: Walk to the snack cart.
Take the popcorn and the drink, one in each hand.
Carry both snacks to the cinema door.
Height check! Stand still and stand tall (Legs: hold Shift to go on tiptoe).
Ask Pip for one ticket (Head: press T and ask him, or hold Space to mumble).
Walk in through the door with both snacks.

drive.name: Driving test
drive.intro: The finale. Pass Mr Price's driving test before his "?" fills up. Legs: pedals. Arms: the wheel. Head: mirrors and nodding.

steps.text: Check your mirrors: Head looks left, then right.
Drive to the stop line and stop on it (only the Legs can see it).
Weave through the cones without knocking any over.
Turn the car around in the road (forward, back, forward is fine).
Drive back down the street. When Mr Price shouts STOP, stop!
Check your mirrors again before you pull away.
Park in the box by the corner shop (only the Legs can see it).
